description.description: A screenshot of a post on X (formerly Twitter) by the user Andrew Tate. The post features his profile picture, his handle @Cobratate, a verified blue checkmark, and a chess piece icon. The text of the post claims that he bet 10 million on himself to lose a fight at +780 odds, resulting in an 88 million dollar profit.
